name: Installed software list (Windows)
description: Lists installed programs from the 64-bit, 32-bit and loaded user uninstall registry keys, de-duplicated and sorted by name.

params.name: limit
params.label: Maximum rows
params.description: Maximum number of programs to list (10 to 1000).

output: Table of name, version, publisher. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad limit.
